description.html: HabiStat Repton is an insect dusting powder made to correct the poor nutritional value of some feeder insects. It is a complete supplement with vitamins, minerals and amino acids: it contains vitamins A, D3, E, C and K3, B-group vitamins, soy protein and minerals such as iron, zinc, manganese and copper.
The ultra-fine formula makes Repton stick evenly to insects, so it is easy to apply, wastes little, and the animal gets the full range of the supplement with every dusted insect.

Manufacturer's instructions: lightly dust all insects or vegetation before feeding on every 8th feed. A quarter of a teaspoon is enough. Put insects in a bag or tub with the powder, shake and offer them right away. Store in a cool, dry place; for animal use only.
The 40 g pouch suits one or two animals. For larger collections there is HabiStat Repton in a 100 g pot. Use calcium between Repton days; you will find all supplements in our equipment range.
Order by phone or WhatsApp. We ship by courier across Serbia. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order in person. If you need advice on use or dosage - contact us, we are happy to help.
